component.name: Moneypenny
component.summary: Manage the passwords and secrets in your keyrings

description.p: Moneypenny is a GNOME-style manager for the passwords and other secrets that apps store in your keyrings. It works with oo7, the Secret Service provider used by Fedora, and with any other Secret Service.

ul.li: Browse and search your keyrings and the secrets in them
Reveal or copy a secret; the clipboard clears itself after 15 seconds
Create, lock, unlock and delete keyrings, and change their passwords
Updates live when other apps change your keyrings

description.p: Keyring passwords are always entered in the system's own password dialog, never in Moneypenny.
